scope: READ-ONLY audit of corridor 3,6A,6B,9,12 against the visual guide and original native reference kit. No art, bank, metadata, runtime C, ROM or emulator mutations.
overall_verdict: The five corridors do not form a stylistically coherent continuation of the approved native kit.9 is the clearest failure; 12 also departs in projection and material handling. 3 retains the exact church language but juxtaposes it with untextured new surfaces. 6A/6B retain a common new kit with each other but do not retain the existing worn tunnel language.
what_previous_approval_proved: Whole landmark silhouettes, framing, contact and atlas/geometry correctness. Those checks did not validate the requested camera projection, pixel texture, palette/material continuity or story identity. The previous visual_runtime_accepted labels are superseded for style acceptance by this audit.

evidence.reference_overlay_limit: Reference panels include the existing hero pixels only as a QA scale overlay; they are not new game assets or original runtime screenshots.
evidence.metric_limit: Modal-color fractions characterize the specified material patches, not a numeric quality score. Roof ratios are authored shape proxies, not camera-angle measurements.

standards.rule: Orthographic elevated camera near 60 degrees above the ground, following the existing courtyard/actors; normalize camera, scale, palette and anchors.
Corridors use modules/landmarks/circular scrolling without evident repetition of the same room.
3 reuses existing urban floor, gutter, houses and gates; arrival matches 4.
6A reuses tunnel walls, pipes and floor; maintenance tunnel provides the kit.
6B is an alternate branch of the same 6Asewer kit.
9 reuses 3 urban kit and existing industrial gates/pipes; avoid another entire street library; destination facade reappears in 10/11.
12 reuses pipes/floor/corridor landmarks and shipyard infrastructure; arrival is the workers room.

general_findings.finding: 9 has frontal facade dominance. Office roof 56 px over total 160(35%); dock roof 64 over 160(40%).12 union roof 88 over 176(50%). The original courtyard church has roughly 60–65 px of roof over 25–30 px of facade; its top plane dominates. Scrolling the camera to fit a tall facade preserves the different projection instead of normalizing it.
general_findings.inference_limit: These ratios visibly compare top-versus-front balance; a precise angle cannot be recovered from unknown building depth.

general_findings.finding: Existing floors remain quiet while carrying sparse 1 px grain: selected R01 patch 94.8% base with 11 colors; R04 patch 93.4% base with 3 colors. Selected 3/9/12 patches are 100% onecolor. 6A/Bpatches carry two colors almost only in straight paving joints. The old worn world becomes clean flat fields.

Reference plaster, tiles, stone and tunnel pipes use irregular 1 px edges, chips, dirt and rusty transitions. 9/12 quantize structural crops on 2 px grids and repeat uniform wall samples; only openings retain 1 px details. Clean rectangular walls, unweathered metal and regular tree/fence repeats are materially different from the native worn kit. Adding noise to these frontal shapes alone would not repair camera/style.

The 32x 48 cell remains correct, with about 33 px visible human height.9 office front 104 px is about 3 visible human heights; the reference church front is about 25–30 px.12 union front 88 px is about 2.7 human heights. This creates a different apparent storey/camera scale even while 32x 40 doors seem locally usable. Whole-building fit and door reachability did not prove the same world scale.

3 uses the old church plus new flat houses;9 introduces a different modern industrial/landscaped kit; 12 uses a third terracotta/blue-garage family. 6A/Bare coherent with each other but replace the worn tunnel material vocabulary with olive paving/navy dashed water. The result reads as several asset packs across one campaign.

preserve: Exact church identity, warm floor hue, blue doors, modular route/arrival function.

failures.issue: Road sampled from a 1x 1 source pixel; selected 64x 64 floor is completely uniform against the grainy church.
New plaster is literally a 1x 1 sample repeated across walls. Clean green parcels and plaster contrast with the worn church/old enclosure.

phases.story: Street, abandoned vehicle and warehouse arrival match the stated journey in function; the church-to-new-house material jump undermines same-neighborhood continuity.

preserve: Dry escort lane, canal, bridge, maintenance landmarks and shelter direction.

failures.issue: Flat olive paving plus perfect line joints instead of the charcoal/sparse-grain floor and warm rust/dirt transitions of the existing maintenance tunnel.
Canal/walls are almost diagrammatic top-down strips; small 3Ddoors/pumps sit in a different level of finish. Repeated cyan dashes read as a pattern rather than the old material vocabulary.

phases.story: Sewer/dry path/shelter are readable. The reason to reuse the existing maintenance kit was not realized in materials.

preserve: Shared base with 6A, two gate/pressure sequences and alternate branch consequence.

failures.issue: Same clean olive paving and regular joints as 6A.
Valve/gate have detailed isolated metal silhouettes but their surroundings remain clean flat paving; weathering and pressure/corrosion history do not bind equipment to the environment.

phases.story: The interactive requirements are represented. Gate correctness does not restore the reference sewer material/camera identity.

preserve: Industrial destination intent, whole vehicle, service detour, mechanical/tank yard logic and collision correctness.

failures.issue: Office is dominated by 104 px of front wall under 56 px of roof, with large uniform brick-red planes. Reads as a frontal clean campus building.
Three clean repeated garage doors, blue canopy and same oversized facade projection.
Graphite asphalt is semantically a road after the water-color correction, but remains 100% flat and has no native 1 px surface wear.

The isolated blue gate marks an endpoint but the promised factory silhouette/facade continuity with 10/11 is not established by a shared complete facade. Industrial props alone are not a reused urban-to-factory kit.

phases.story: Reach-factory objective and dialogue fit. Clean landscaping/campus vocabulary weakens the infested industrial setting and introduces a new street library contrary to guide 528–539.

preserve: Union red cloth/blue entrance identity, protected stops, north/south route, whole buildings and escort consequence.

failures.issue: Union roof 88/front 88 creates a frontal facade twice to three times the old projected front height; walls are flat brown and roof details on 2 px grid.
Uniform gray floor with none of the technical plate/channel/scorched maintenance vocabulary proposed inK4F.
Six copies of the same 160x 128 annex fill camera gaps but create a visibly repeated garage family. They solve empty framing without giving shipyard-specific structural progression.

phases.story: Union arrival is clear; the preceding place reads as a workshop neighborhood rather than the last service passage of the spacecraft yard. Few large shipyard modules/pipes/technical ground reused from the final area would establish that connection.

priorities.action: Approve a 320x 2241x/2xstyle proof with existing human sprites againstR01/R03 before extending a whole new corridor. Use the original camera/material kit as the source of truth; a new ImageGen full scene must be normalized to it.
Repair 9 projection and kit continuity first. Reuse native urban/industrial roof, plaster, gate and pipe parts; do not retain tall frontal buildings and simply add dirt.
Restore quiet 1 px material vocabulary: sparse ground grain, worn plaster/stone, rust at metal joints and contact dirt. Preserve low contrast on movement ground; avoid global random noise.
Normalize 12 projection and shipyard infrastructure, and 6A/Btunnel palette/materials. 3 needs targeted surface continuity while keeping its faithful church.
Then review full panorama, entry/middle/arrival cameras and story transition pairs; only afterward redo combined runtime and performance acceptance.

performance_boundary: This audit makes no new FPS measurement.640 tile fit is a VRAM constraint, not proof of smooth normal gameplay. Existing rendering/collision passes and combat-disabled/forced-load captures do not settle the user-reported stutter. Performance remains a separate root investigation.
writes: Only this review directory was written; production sources, generators, manifests, native assets and ROM were not changed.
